name: Premium Wall Shelf Corner
summary: Modular 90-degree corner display with continuous L-shaped shelves.
description: Emerald lacquer/champagne gold two-wing corner fixture, three continuous L-shaped shelves, supported warm LEDs and two independently replaceable blank headers. No products embedded.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Blender Python original geometry and original baked PNG textures; user concept reference, not official brand artwork
accuracy_notes: Conceptual reference-inspired furniture, not official branded merchandise. No structural, lighting-temperature, safety or accessibility certification.
rights: Original geometry and materials; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and baked procedural wood/stone textures. User-supplied concept image used only as visual direction; no logos, packaging artwork or products copied.
